title: Impact of Well-Controlled Type 2 Diabetes on Corneal Endothelium Following Cataract Surgery: A Prospective Longitudinal Analysis
indication: Age-related cataract (LOCS III, nuclear grades 5-6 excluded), age 60-80 years, Caucasian; well-controlled type 2 diabetes on oral therapy (HbA1c of 7% or less, no or mild non-proliferative retinopathy) versus non-diabetic patients operated in the same period; uneventful stop-and-chop phacoemulsification (Centurion) with SN60AT IOL by four surgeons; excluded glaucoma, pseudoexfoliation, corneal dystrophies or scars, low preoperative ECD

groups.description: Study group (DM+): well-controlled type 2 diabetes, 80 eyes of 80 patients
Control group (DM-): no type 2 diabetes, 80 eyes of 80 patients

exclusions.what: jcm-14-03603-t005 R11C2 and jcm-14-03603-t006 R11C2 ('After 6-8 months')
exclusions.reason: visit time given as a range (protocol: ranges are excluded); Methods confirm the visit was between 6 and 8 months

exclusions.what: Median (Q1; Q3) and MD (95% CI) columns of Tables 5-6
exclusions.reason: medians and differences are not admissible

exclusions.what: jcm-14-03603-t008 to t011 (changes and percent changes from baseline)
exclusions.reason: changes of the same groups; the absolute ECD series is used; Table 11 labels the third visit '6 months' while Tables 5-7 and Methods give 6-8 months

exclusions.what: jcm-14-03603-t002 R14 and t003 R13 preoperative ECD

notes: Diabetic and non-diabetic groups are patient-condition subgroups receiving the same standard phacoemulsification; both recorded as control (the authors call DM+ the study group and DM- the control group).
Methods schedule: 2 weeks, 3 months and between 6 and 8 months after surgery; the tables label the first visit 'After 14 days', converted as 14 days.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative central ECD (Nidek CEM-530) of the operated eye, Table 5 'Before surgery'
series.notes: Table 5 ECD rows, 'Mean ± SD' column: before surgery, after 14 days (14/30.4375 months) and after 3 months; the 6-8 month visit is excluded (range); no per-visit n

series.baseline_label: Preoperative central ECD (Nidek CEM-530) of the operated eye, Table 6 'Before surgery'
series.notes: Table 6 ECD rows, 'Mean ± SD' column: before surgery, after 14 days (14/30.4375 months) and after 3 months; the 6-8 month visit is excluded (range); no per-visit n
